scope: S76 only; missing prerequisites never suppress S72, S73, S74 or S75
required_prerequisites: six fixed TRAIN confirmation groups with verified transitive acquisition independence
at least one stable canonical family on all seeds 7,13,23
source-audited scratch Garl event-only 40-channel ResNet50 with required foreground supervision

family_selection.metric: mean of the three old-development seed losses, not averaged TTC

architecture.source_pool: all authorized TRAIN except fixed confirmation and protected roles

garl.initialization: scratch encoder and head for every pilot and final seed
garl.internal_validation: three hashed groups from FINAL TRAIN only, disjoint from confirmation
garl.final_fit: refit selected profile and count on full FINAL TRAIN including pilot validation groups

confirmation.barrier: all three architecture and three Garl endpoints and family decision frozen
confirmation.secondary_metric: pooled release bucket MiD when all four global buckets exist
confirmation.meaningful_win: at least5 MiD improvement, both grouped CI upper bounds below0, full coverage, no material sign/crucial deterioration
confirmation.failed_or_inconclusive: terminal; no new tuning or family against these labels

router_future_comparison.prerequisite: separate full-TRAIN genuinely nested meta-fit with all producer ancestors excluding confirmation; freeze all endpoints before any new evaluation

unresolved_pre_pilot_bindings: exact final sampled tokens and internal hashed group IDs
measured native Garl batch feasibility and explicit schedule mapping
